target.statement: Projected JSD for the Amazon rating–text boundary case: Stilt (text-permutation control) = 0.1017, compared to real reference 0.0000

compute.basis: The target only needs SBERT embeddings of ~6k short texts (all-MiniLM-L6-v2 runs on CPU in a few minutes), k-means with K=20, quantile binning, and a 2D contingency-table JSD; the permutation control is a simple shuffle, and the released repo plus Zenodo archive should provide the pipeline, though the Amazon subset may need to be reconstructed from the public source.

blockers: The exact 6,064-record Amazon preprocessing subset may need to be reconstructed from the public Amazon Reviews source if the repo does not ship the processed split
The paper's LLM baselines use an internal eBay GPT-5.2 deployment; the released code substitutes GPT-4o-mini, but the target (Stilt) does not require any LLM
title: Beyond the Stitching Assumption: A Unified Framework for Multimodal Synthetic Data Evaluation via Semantic Quantization
